crossRefs.note: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
His father refused, and said, “I know, my son, I know. He also will become a people, and he also will be great.…
He blessed them that day, saying, “Israel will bless in you, saying, ‘God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh’ ” He set…

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.
